      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy-dark) 0%, var(--navy) 40%, #243f5f 100%);
      padding-top: 72px;
    }
    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 50%, rgba(196,30,58,0.15) 0%, transparent 60%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 20%, rgba(43,80,128,0.3) 0%, transparent 50%);
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .hero::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 200px;
      background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--white), transparent);
      z-index: 2;
    }
    .hero-pattern {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      opacity: 0.04;
      background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='60' height='60' viewBox='0 0 60 60' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cg fill='none' fill-rule='evenodd'%3E%3Cg fill='%23ffffff'%3E%3Cpath d='M36 34v-4h-2v4h-4v2h4v4h2v-4h4v-2h-4zm0-30V0h-2v4h-4v2h4v4h2V6h4V4h-4zM6 34v-4H4v4H0v2h4v4h2v-4h4v-2H6zM6 4V0H4v4H0v2h4v4h2V6h4V4H6z'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E");
      z-index: 0;
    }

    .hero-content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 3;
      max-width: 680px;
      padding: 80px 0 120px;
    }
    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 6px 16px;
      background: rgba(196,30,58,0.2);
      border: 1px solid rgba(196,30,58,0.3);
      border-radius: 100px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
      animation: fadeSlideDown 0.8s ease-out both;
    }
    .hero-badge .pulse-dot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      background: var(--red-light);
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: pulse 2s infinite;
    }
    @keyframes pulse {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
      50% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(1.3); }
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(40px, 6vw, 72px);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: white;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      animation: fadeSlideDown 0.8s ease-out 0.15s both;
    }
    .hero-title .accent { color: var(--red-light); }

    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: clamp(16px, 2vw, 19px);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
      max-width: 540px;
      animation: fadeSlideDown 0.8s ease-out 0.3s both;
    }

    .hero-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      animation: fadeSlideDown 0.8s ease-out 0.45s both;
    }
    .hero-actions .btn-primary { box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(196,30,58,0.4); font-size: 16px; padding: 14px 36px; }
    .hero-actions .btn-secondary { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); color: white; }
    .hero-actions .btn-secondary:hover { border-color: white; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }

    .hero-image-area {
      position: absolute;
      right: 0;
      top: 72px;
      bottom: 0;
      width: 45%;
      z-index: 2;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero-image-area img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      opacity: 0.35;
    }

    @keyframes fadeSlideDown {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    /* ===== MISSION ===== */
    .mission {
      padding: 100px 0 80px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .mission-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 80px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .mission-label {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--red);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .mission-title {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }
    .mission-text {
      font-size: 17px;
      line-height: 1.75;
      color: var(--gray-600);
    }
    .mission-text strong { color: var(--gray-800); }
    .mission-visual {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gray-100) 0%, var(--gray-200) 100%);
    }
    .mission-visual .placeholder-img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      opacity: 0;
    }
    .mission-visual .overlay-text {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(27,58,92,0.85), rgba(27,58,92,0.7));
      color: white;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 40px;
    }
    .mission-visual .overlay-text .big-number {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 64px;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .mission-visual .overlay-text .big-label {
      font-size: 16px;
      opacity: 0.8;
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    .mission-visual .quote-mark {
      position: absolute;
      top: 20px;
      left: 24px;
      font-size: 80px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      font-family: Georgia, serif;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    /* ===== IMPACT STATS ===== */
    .impact {
      padding: 80px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--gray-50) 0%, var(--white) 100%);
      position: relative;
    }
    .impact::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 1px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--gray-300), transparent);
    }
    .impact-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 64px;
    }
    .impact-header .label {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--red);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .impact-header h2 {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .impact-header p {
      max-width: 600px;
      margin: 16px auto 0;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-size: 17px;
    }

    .stats-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
    }
    .stat-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 40px 28px;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: var(--transition-base);
    }
    .stat-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 4px;
      background: var(--red);
      transform: scaleX(0);
      transform-origin: left;
      transition: transform var(--transition-slow);
    }
    .stat-card:hover::before { transform: scaleX(1); }
    .stat-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); transform: translateY(-4px); }

    .stat-number {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(36px, 4vw, 52px);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .stat-unit {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--red);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .stat-label {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .stat-icon {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin: 0 auto 20px;
      color: var(--navy);
    }

    /* ===== PROGRAMS ===== */
    .programs {
      padding: 100px 0;
    }
    .programs-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 56px;
    }
    .programs-header .label {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--red);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .programs-header h2 {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .accordion {
      max-width: 800px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .accordion-item {
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: var(--transition-base);
    }
    .accordion-item:hover { border-color: var(--gray-300); }
    .accordion-item.active { border-color: var(--red); box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(196,30,58,0.08); }

    .accordion-trigger {
      width: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 20px 24px;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      background: var(--white);
      transition: background var(--transition-fast);
      text-align: left;
    }
    .accordion-trigger:hover { background: var(--gray-50); }
    .accordion-item.active .accordion-trigger { color: var(--red); background: rgba(196,30,58,0.03); }

    .accordion-trigger .trigger-left {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
    }
    .accordion-trigger .prog-icon {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--navy);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }
    .accordion-item.active .prog-icon { background: rgba(196,30,58,0.1); color: var(--red); }

    .accordion-trigger .chevron {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      transition: transform var(--transition-base);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .accordion-item.active .chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); color: var(--red); }

    .accordion-content {
      max-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: max-height var(--transition-slow), padding var(--transition-slow);
    }
    .accordion-content-inner {
      padding: 0 24px 20px 78px;
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      color: var(--gray-600);
    }
    .accordion-content-inner a {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      color: var(--red);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 14px;
      margin-top: 12px;
      transition: gap var(--transition-fast);
    }
    .accordion-content-inner a:hover { gap: 10px; }

    /* ===== GET INVOLVED ===== */
    .involved {
      padding: 100px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--white) 0%, var(--gray-50) 100%);
    }
    .involved-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 56px;
    }
    .involved-header .label {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--red);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .involved-header h2 {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .involved-header p {
      max-width: 540px;
      margin: 16px auto 0;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-size: 17px;
    }

    .involved-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 28px;
    }
    .involved-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 40px 32px;
      transition: var(--transition-base);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .involved-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 3px;
      background: var(--navy);
      transition: height var(--transition-base);
    }
    .involved-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); transform: translateY(-4px); }
    .involved-card:hover::before { height: 4px; }

    .involved-card .card-icon {
      width: 56px;
      height: 56px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy), var(--navy-light));
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: white;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .involved-card h3 {
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    }
    .involved-card p {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      line-height: 1.65;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .involved-card .card-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--navy);
      transition: gap var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast);
    }
    .involved-card:hover .card-cta { color: var(--red); gap: 12px; }

    /* ===== NEWS ===== */
    .news {
      padding: 100px 0;
    }
    .news-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }
    .news-header .label {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--red);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .news-header h2 {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .carousel-controls {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .carousel-btn {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-300);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
      background: var(--white);
    }
    .carousel-btn:hover { border-color: var(--navy); color: var(--navy); background: var(--gray-50); }
    .carousel-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(196,30,58,0.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

    .news-carousel-wrapper {
      overflow: hidden;
      margin: 0 -24px;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }
    .news-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 28px;
      transition: transform var(--transition-slow);
    }
    .news-card {
      flex: 0 0 calc(50% - 14px);
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: var(--transition-base);
    }
    .news-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); transform: translateY(-3px); }

    .news-card-image {
      height: 200px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gray-100), var(--gray-200));
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      font-size: 40px;
    }
    .news-card-image .image-label {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 12px;
      left: 12px;
      background: var(--red);
      color: white;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    .news-card-body { padding: 24px; }
    .news-card-body h3 {
      font-size: 19px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }
    .news-card-body p {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* ===== DONATE CTA ===== */
    .donate-cta {
      padding: 100px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy-dark) 0%, var(--navy) 50%, #2a4f70 100%);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .donate-cta::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 50%, rgba(196,30,58,0.12) 0%, transparent 60%);
    }
    .donate-cta .container { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

    .donate-cta-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 80px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .donate-cta .label {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .donate-cta h2 {
      font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 48px);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: white;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      line-height: 1.15;
    }
    .donate-cta .cta-text {
      font-size: 17px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }
    .donate-cta .efficiency-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 8px 16px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      border-radius: 100px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }
    .efficiency-badge .check-icon { color: #4ade80; }

    .impact-table {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 32px;
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    }
    .impact-table h3 {
      color: white;
      font-size: 20px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .impact-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 16px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    }
    .impact-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .impact-amount {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--red-light);
      min-width: 72px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .impact-desc {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    .impact-table .btn-primary {
      width: 100%;
      margin-top: 24px;
      padding: 16px;
      font-size: 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    }

    /* ===== FOOTER ===== */
    .footer {
      background: var(--gray-900);
      color: var(--gray-400);
      padding: 80px 0 40px;
    }
    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 48px;
      margin-bottom: 56px;
    }
    .footer-brand .footer-logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 18px;
      color: white;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .footer-brand .footer-logo .logo-icon {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      background: var(--red);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: white;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .footer-brand p {
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      max-width: 280px;
    }
    .footer-col h4 {
      color: white;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .footer-col a {
      display: block;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      padding: 5px 0;
      transition: color var(--transition-fast);
    }
    .footer-col a:hover { color: white; }

    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      padding-top: 32px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .footer-bottom p { font-size: 13px; }
    .footer-social {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .footer-social a {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      font-size: 14px;
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }
    .footer-social a:hover { border-color: var(--red); color: var(--red); background: rgba(196,30,58,0.1); }

    /* ===== DONATE MODAL ===== */
    .modal-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(26,22,20,0.6);
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
      z-index: 2000;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 24px;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transition: all var(--transition-base);
    }
    .modal-overlay.open { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; }

    .modal {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      max-width: 520px;
      width: 100%;
      max-height: 90vh;
      overflow-y: auto;
      transform: translateY(20px) scale(0.97);
      transition: transform var(--transition-base);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
    }
    .modal-overlay.open .modal { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }

    .modal-header {
      padding: 28px 32px 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }
    .modal-header h2 {
      font-size: 24px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .modal-close {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .modal-close:hover { background: var(--gray-100); color: var(--gray-700); }

    .modal-body { padding: 24px 32px 32px; }
    .modal-body .modal-subtitle {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .amount-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .amount-btn {
      padding: 14px 8px;
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      text-align: center;
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
      background: var(--white);
    }
    .amount-btn:hover { border-color: var(--navy); color: var(--navy); }
    .amount-btn.selected { border-color: var(--red); background: rgba(196,30,58,0.05); color: var(--red); }
    .amount-btn .amount-label {
      display: block;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      margin-top: 2px;
      font-family: var(--font-body);
    }

    .custom-amount {
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .custom-amount input {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-size: 16px;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color var(--transition-fast);
    }
    .custom-amount input:focus { border-color: var(--navy); }
    .custom-amount input::placeholder { color: var(--gray-300); font-weight: 400; }

    .frequency-toggle {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .freq-btn {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 10px;
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-align: center;
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--gray-600);
    }
    .freq-btn:hover { border-color: var(--navy); }
    .freq-btn.selected { border-color: var(--navy); background: var(--navy); color: white; }

    .modal-donate-btn {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 16px;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      background: var(--red);
      color: white;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(196,30,58,0.3);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }
    .modal-donate-btn:hover { background: var(--red-dark); box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(196,30,58,0.4); transform: translateY(-1px); }

    .modal-secure {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-top: 16px;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }

    /* ===== SECTION REVEAL ANIMATION ===== */
    .reveal {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(30px);
      transition: opacity 0.7s ease-out, transform 0.7s ease-out;
    }
    .reveal.visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    /* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
    @media (max-width: 1200px) {
      .hero-image-area { width: 40%; }
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .header-nav { display: none; }
      .utility-links { display: none; }
      .hamburger { display: flex; }
      .mobile-drawer { display: block; }

      .hero-image-area { display: none; }

  <script>
    // ===== HEADER SCROLL EFFECT =====
    const header = document.getElementById('header');
    let lastScroll = 0;
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      const scrollY = window.scrollY;
      if (scrollY > 10) {
        header.classList.add('scrolled');
      } else {
        header.classList.remove('scrolled');
      }
      lastScroll = scrollY;
    }, { passive: true });

    // ===== MOBILE MENU =====
    const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
    const mobileDrawer = document.getElementById('mobileDrawer');

    hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const isOpen = hamburger.classList.toggle('active');
      mobileDrawer.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
      mobileDrawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', !isOpen);
      document.body.style.overflow = isOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
    });

    // Close mobile menu on link click
    mobileDrawer.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => {
      link.addEventListener('click', () => {
        hamburger.classList.remove('active');
        mobileDrawer.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        mobileDrawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
      });
    });

    // ===== DONATE MODAL =====
    const donateModal = document.getElementById('donateModal');
    const modalClose = document.getElementById('modalClose');
    const donateTriggers = document.querySelectorAll('.donate-trigger');
    const amountGrid = document.getElementById('amountGrid');
    const customAmountInput = document.getElementById('customAmount');
    const frequencyToggle = document.getElementById('frequencyToggle');
    const confirmDonate = document.getElementById('confirmDonate');
    let selectedAmount = 50;
    let selectedFreq = 'one-time';

    function openModal() {
      donateModal.classList.add('open');
      donateModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      donateModal.querySelector('.modal-close').focus();
    }

    function closeModal() {
      donateModal.classList.remove('open');
      donateModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    donateTriggers.forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', openModal));
    modalClose.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
    donateModal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === donateModal) closeModal();
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && donateModal.classList.contains('open')) closeModal();
    });

    // Amount selection
    amountGrid.querySelectorAll('.amount-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        amountGrid.querySelectorAll('.amount-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
        btn.classList.add('selected');
        selectedAmount = parseInt(btn.dataset.amount);
        customAmountInput.value = '';
        updateConfirmBtn();
      });
    });

    customAmountInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
      if (customAmountInput.value) {
        amountGrid.querySelectorAll('.amount-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
        selectedAmount = parseInt(customAmountInput.value) || 0;
      }
      updateConfirmBtn();
    });

    // Frequency toggle
    frequencyToggle.querySelectorAll('.freq-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        frequencyToggle.querySelectorAll('.freq-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
        btn.classList.add('selected');
        selectedFreq = btn.dataset.freq;
        updateConfirmBtn();
      });
    });

    function updateConfirmBtn() {
      const amount = selectedAmount || 0;
      const suffix = selectedFreq === 'monthly' ? '/month' : '';
      confirmDonate.textContent = `Donate $${amount.toLocaleString()}${suffix}`;
    }

    // ===== PROGRAM ACCORDION =====
    const accordionItems = document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-item');
    accordionItems.forEach((item, index) => {
      const trigger = item.querySelector('.accordion-trigger');
      const content = item.querySelector('.accordion-content');

      // Set first item open by default
      if (index === 0) {
        item.classList.add('active');
        content.style.maxHeight = content.scrollHeight + 'px';
      }

      trigger.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const isActive = item.classList.contains('active');

        // Close all
        accordionItems.forEach(i => {
          i.classList.remove('active');
          i.querySelector('.accordion-trigger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          i.querySelector('.accordion-content').style.maxHeight = '0';
        });

        // Open clicked if it wasn't active
        if (!isActive) {
          item.classList.add('active');
          trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
          content.style.maxHeight = content.scrollHeight + 'px';
        }
      });
    });

    // ===== NEWS CAROUSEL =====
    const newsTrack = document.getElementById('newsTrack');
    const prevBtn = document.getElementById('carouselPrev');
    const nextBtn = document.getElementById('carouselNext');
    let carouselIndex = 0;

    function getCardsPerView() {
      if (window.innerWidth <= 768) return 1;
      return 2;
    }

    function getTotalCards() {
      return newsTrack.querySelectorAll('.news-card').length;
    }

    function updateCarousel() {
      const cardsPerView = getCardsPerView();
      const totalCards = getTotalCards();
      const maxIndex = Math.max(0, totalCards - cardsPerView);
      carouselIndex = Math.min(carouselIndex, maxIndex);

      const card = newsTrack.querySelector('.news-card');
      const gap = 28;
      const cardWidth = card.offsetWidth + gap;
      newsTrack.style.transform = `translateX(-${carouselIndex * cardWidth}px)`;
    }

    prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (carouselIndex > 0) {
        carouselIndex--;
        updateCarousel();
      }
    });

    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const cardsPerView = getCardsPerView();
      const totalCards = getTotalCards();
      const maxIndex = Math.max(0, totalCards - cardsPerView);
      if (carouselIndex < maxIndex) {
        carouselIndex++;
        updateCarousel();
      }
    });

    window.addEventListener('resize', updateCarousel);

    // ===== ANIMATED COUNTERS =====
    function animateCounter(el) {
      const target = parseInt(el.dataset.target);
      const prefix = el.dataset.prefix || '';
      const suffix = el.dataset.suffix || '';
      const duration = 2000;
      const start = performance.now();

      function easeOutQuart(t) {
        return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 4);
      }

      function update(now) {
        const elapsed = now - start;
        const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
        const easedProgress = easeOutQuart(progress);
        const current = Math.floor(easedProgress * target);

        el.textContent = prefix + current.toLocaleString() + (progress >= 1 ? suffix : '');

        if (progress < 1) {
          requestAnimationFrame(update);
        }
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(update);
    }

    // ===== SCROLL REVEAL =====
    const revealElements = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
    const statNumbers = document.querySelectorAll('.stat-number');
    let statsAnimated = false;

    const observerOptions = {
      threshold: 0.15,
      rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px'
    };

    const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('visible');

          // Animate stats when they become visible
          if (!statsAnimated && entry.target.querySelector('.stat-number')) {
            statsAnimated = true;
            statNumbers.forEach(el => animateCounter(el));
          }

          revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, observerOptions);

    revealElements.forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));

    // Also observe stat cards directly
    const statsSection = document.querySelector('.stats-grid');
    if (statsSection) {
      const statsObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting && !statsAnimated) {
            statsAnimated = true;
            statNumbers.forEach(el => animateCounter(el));
            statsObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.3 });
      statsObserver.observe(statsSection);
    }

    // ===== SMOOTH SCROLL FOR ANCHOR LINKS =====
    document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
      anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        const href = this.getAttribute('href');
        if (href === '#') return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const target = document.querySelector(href);
        if (target) {
          const headerHeight = 72;
          const targetPosition = target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - headerHeight;
          window.scrollTo({ top: targetPosition, behavior: 'smooth' });
        }
      });
    });
  </script>

</body>
</html>

    .btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(196,30,58,0.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

    /* Hamburger */
    .hamburger {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
      padding: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      z-index: 1001;
    }
    .hamburger span {
      display: block;
      width: 22px;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--gray-800);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: var(--transition-base);
    }
    .hamburger.active span:nth-child(1) { transform: rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 5px); }
    .hamburger.active span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
    .hamburger.active span:nth-child(3) { transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(5px, -5px); }

    /* Mobile drawer */
    .mobile-drawer {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      top: 72px;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      background: var(--white);
      z-index: 999;
      padding: 32px 24px;
      transform: translateX(100%);
      transition: transform var(--transition-slow);
      overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .mobile-drawer.open { transform: translateX(0); }
    .mobile-drawer a {
      display: block;
      padding: 14px 0;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
    }
    .mobile-drawer .mobile-donate-btn {
      margin-top: 24px;
      width: 100%;
      text-align: center;
    }

    /* ===== HERO ===== */
    .hero {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 92vh;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy-dark) 0%, var(--navy) 40%, #243f5f 100%);
      padding-top: 72px;
    }
    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 50%, rgba(196,30,58,0.15) 0%, transparent 60%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 20%, rgba(43,80,128,0.3) 0%, transparent 50%);
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .hero::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 200px;
      background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--white), transparent);
      z-index: 2;
    }
    .hero-pattern {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      opacity: 0.04;
      background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='60' height='60' viewBox='0 0 60 60' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cg fill='none' fill-rule='evenodd'%3E%3Cg fill='%23ffffff'%3E%3Cpath d='M36 34v-4h-2v4h-4v2h4v4h2v-4h4v-2h-4zm0-30V0h-2v4h-4v2h4v4h2V6h4V4h-4zM6 34v-4H4v4H0v2h4v4h2v-4h4v-2H6zM6 4V0H4v4H0v2h4v4h2V6h4V4H6z'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E");
      z-index: 0;
    }

    .hero-content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 3;
      max-width: 680px;
      padding: 80px 0 120px;
    }
    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 6px 16px;
      background: rgba(196,30,58,0.2);
      border: 1px solid rgba(196,30,58,0.3);
      border-radius: 100px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
      animation: fadeSlideDown 0.8s ease-out both;
    }
    .hero-badge .pulse-dot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      background: var(--red-light);
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: pulse 2s infinite;
    }
    @keyframes pulse {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
      50% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(1.3); }
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(40px, 6vw, 72px);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: white;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      animation: fadeSlideDown 0.8s ease-out 0.15s both;
    }
    .hero-title .accent { color: var(--red-light); }

    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: clamp(16px, 2vw, 19px);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
      max-width: 540px;
      animation: fadeSlideDown 0.8s ease-out 0.3s both;
    }

    .hero-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      animation: fadeSlideDown 0.8s ease-out 0.45s both;
    }
    .hero-actions .btn-primary { box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(196,30,58,0.4); font-size: 16px; padding: 14px 36px; }
    .hero-actions .btn-secondary { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); color: white; }
    .hero-actions .btn-secondary:hover { border-color: white; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }

    .hero-image-area {
      position: absolute;
      right: 0;
      top: 72px;
      bottom: 0;
      width: 45%;
      z-index: 2;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero-image-area img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      opacity: 0.35;
    }

    @keyframes fadeSlideDown {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    /* ===== MISSION ===== */
    .mission {
      padding: 100px 0 80px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .mission-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 80px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .mission-label {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--red);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .mission-title {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }
    .mission-text {
      font-size: 17px;
      line-height: 1.75;
      color: var(--gray-600);
    }
    .mission-text strong { color: var(--gray-800); }
    .mission-visual {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gray-100) 0%, var(--gray-200) 100%);
    }
    .mission-visual .placeholder-img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      opacity: 0;
    }
    .mission-visual .overlay-text {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(27,58,92,0.85), rgba(27,58,92,0.7));
      color: white;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 40px;
    }
    .mission-visual .overlay-text .big-number {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 64px;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .mission-visual .overlay-text .big-label {
      font-size: 16px;
      opacity: 0.8;
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    .mission-visual .quote-mark {
      position: absolute;
      top: 20px;
      left: 24px;
      font-size: 80px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      font-family: Georgia, serif;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    /* ===== IMPACT STATS ===== */
    .impact {
      padding: 80px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--gray-50) 0%, var(--white) 100%);
      position: relative;
    }
    .impact::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 1px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--gray-300), transparent);
    }
    .impact-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 64px;
    }
    .impact-header .label {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--red);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .impact-header h2 {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .impact-header p {
      max-width: 600px;
      margin: 16px auto 0;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-size: 17px;
    }

    .stats-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
    }
    .stat-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 40px 28px;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: var(--transition-base);
    }
    .stat-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 4px;
      background: var(--red);
      transform: scaleX(0);
      transform-origin: left;
      transition: transform var(--transition-slow);
    }
    .stat-card:hover::before { transform: scaleX(1); }
    .stat-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); transform: translateY(-4px); }

    .stat-number {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(36px, 4vw, 52px);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .stat-unit {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--red);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .stat-label {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .stat-icon {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin: 0 auto 20px;
      color: var(--navy);
    }

    /* ===== PROGRAMS ===== */
    .programs {
      padding: 100px 0;
    }
    .programs-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 56px;
    }
    .programs-header .label {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--red);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .programs-header h2 {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .accordion {
      max-width: 800px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .accordion-item {
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: var(--transition-base);
    }
    .accordion-item:hover { border-color: var(--gray-300); }
    .accordion-item.active { border-color: var(--red); box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(196,30,58,0.08); }

    .accordion-trigger {
      width: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 20px 24px;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      background: var(--white);
      transition: background var(--transition-fast);
      text-align: left;
    }
    .accordion-trigger:hover { background: var(--gray-50); }
    .accordion-item.active .accordion-trigger { color: var(--red); background: rgba(196,30,58,0.03); }

    .accordion-trigger .trigger-left {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
    }
    .accordion-trigger .prog-icon {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--navy);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }
    .accordion-item.active .prog-icon { background: rgba(196,30,58,0.1); color: var(--red); }

    .accordion-trigger .chevron {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      transition: transform var(--transition-base);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .accordion-item.active .chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); color: var(--red); }

    .accordion-content {
      max-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: max-height var(--transition-slow), padding var(--transition-slow);
    }
    .accordion-content-inner {
      padding: 0 24px 20px 78px;
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      color: var(--gray-600);
    }
    .accordion-content-inner a {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      color: var(--red);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 14px;
      margin-top: 12px;
      transition: gap var(--transition-fast);
    }
    .accordion-content-inner a:hover { gap: 10px; }

    /* ===== GET INVOLVED ===== */
    .involved {
      padding: 100px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--white) 0%, var(--gray-50) 100%);
    }
    .involved-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 56px;
    }
    .involved-header .label {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--red);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .involved-header h2 {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .involved-header p {
      max-width: 540px;
      margin: 16px auto 0;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-size: 17px;
    }

    .involved-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 28px;
    }
    .involved-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 40px 32px;
      transition: var(--transition-base);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .involved-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 3px;
      background: var(--navy);
      transition: height var(--transition-base);
    }
    .involved-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); transform: translateY(-4px); }
    .involved-card:hover::before { height: 4px; }

    .involved-card .card-icon {
      width: 56px;
      height: 56px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy), var(--navy-light));
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: white;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .involved-card h3 {
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    }
    .involved-card p {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      line-height: 1.65;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .involved-card .card-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--navy);
      transition: gap var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast);
    }
    .involved-card:hover .card-cta { color: var(--red); gap: 12px; }

    /* ===== NEWS ===== */
    .news {
      padding: 100px 0;
    }
    .news-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }
    .news-header .label {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--red);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .news-header h2 {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .carousel-controls {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .carousel-btn {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-300);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
      background: var(--white);
    }
    .carousel-btn:hover { border-color: var(--navy); color: var(--navy); background: var(--gray-50); }
    .carousel-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(196,30,58,0.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

    .news-carousel-wrapper {
      overflow: hidden;
      margin: 0 -24px;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }
    .news-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 28px;
      transition: transform var(--transition-slow);
    }
    .news-card {
      flex: 0 0 calc(50% - 14px);
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: var(--transition-base);
    }
    .news-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); transform: translateY(-3px); }

    .news-card-image {
      height: 200px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gray-100), var(--gray-200));
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      font-size: 40px;
    }
    .news-card-image .image-label {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 12px;
      left: 12px;
      background: var(--red);
      color: white;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    .news-card-body { padding: 24px; }
    .news-card-body h3 {
      font-size: 19px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }
    .news-card-body p {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* ===== DONATE CTA ===== */
    .donate-cta {
      padding: 100px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy-dark) 0%, var(--navy) 50%, #2a4f70 100%);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .donate-cta::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 50%, rgba(196,30,58,0.12) 0%, transparent 60%);
    }
    .donate-cta .container { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

    .donate-cta-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 80px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .donate-cta .label {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .donate-cta h2 {
      font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 48px);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: white;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      line-height: 1.15;
    }
    .donate-cta .cta-text {
      font-size: 17px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }
    .donate-cta .efficiency-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 8px 16px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      border-radius: 100px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }
    .efficiency-badge .check-icon { color: #4ade80; }

    .impact-table {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 32px;
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    }
    .impact-table h3 {
      color: white;
      font-size: 20px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .impact-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 16px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    }
    .impact-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .impact-amount {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--red-light);
      min-width: 72px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .impact-desc {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    .impact-table .btn-primary {
      width: 100%;
      margin-top: 24px;
      padding: 16px;
      font-size: 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    }

    /* ===== FOOTER ===== */
    .footer {
      background: var(--gray-900);
      color: var(--gray-400);
      padding: 80px 0 40px;
    }
    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 48px;
      margin-bottom: 56px;
    }
    .footer-brand .footer-logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 18px;
      color: white;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .footer-brand .footer-logo .logo-icon {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      background: var(--red);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: white;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .footer-brand p {
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      max-width: 280px;
    }
    .footer-col h4 {
      color: white;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .footer-col a {
      display: block;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      padding: 5px 0;
      transition: color var(--transition-fast);
    }
    .footer-col a:hover { color: white; }

    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      padding-top: 32px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .footer-bottom p { font-size: 13px; }
    .footer-social {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .footer-social a {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      font-size: 14px;
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }
    .footer-social a:hover { border-color: var(--red); color: var(--red); background: rgba(196,30,58,0.1); }

    /* ===== DONATE MODAL ===== */
    .modal-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(26,22,20,0.6);
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
      z-index: 2000;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 24px;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transition: all var(--transition-base);
    }
    .modal-overlay.open { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; }

    .modal {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      max-width: 520px;
      width: 100%;
      max-height: 90vh;
      overflow-y: auto;
      transform: translateY(20px) scale(0.97);
      transition: transform var(--transition-base);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
    }
    .modal-overlay.open .modal { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }

    .modal-header {
      padding: 28px 32px 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }
    .modal-header h2 {
      font-size: 24px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .modal-close {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .modal-close:hover { background: var(--gray-100); color: var(--gray-700); }

    .modal-body { padding: 24px 32px 32px; }
    .modal-body .modal-subtitle {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .amount-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .amount-btn {
      padding: 14px 8px;
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      text-align: center;
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
      background: var(--white);
    }
    .amount-btn:hover { border-color: var(--navy); color: var(--navy); }
    .amount-btn.selected { border-color: var(--red); background: rgba(196,30,58,0.05); color: var(--red); }
    .amount-btn .amount-label {
      display: block;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      margin-top: 2px;
      font-family: var(--font-body);
    }

    .custom-amount {
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .custom-amount input {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-size: 16px;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color var(--transition-fast);
    }
    .custom-amount input:focus { border-color: var(--navy); }
    .custom-amount input::placeholder { color: var(--gray-300); font-weight: 400; }

    .frequency-toggle {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .freq-btn {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 10px;
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-align: center;
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--gray-600);
    }
    .freq-btn:hover { border-color: var(--navy); }
    .freq-btn.selected { border-color: var(--navy); background: var(--navy); color: white; }

    .modal-donate-btn {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 16px;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      background: var(--red);
      color: white;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(196,30,58,0.3);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }
    .modal-donate-btn:hover { background: var(--red-dark); box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(196,30,58,0.4); transform: translateY(-1px); }

    .modal-secure {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-top: 16px;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }

    /* ===== SECTION REVEAL ANIMATION ===== */
    .reveal {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(30px);
      transition: opacity 0.7s ease-out, transform 0.7s ease-out;
    }
    .reveal.visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    /* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
    @media (max-width: 1200px) {
      .hero-image-area { width: 40%; }
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .header-nav { display: none; }
      .utility-links { display: none; }
      .hamburger { display: flex; }
      .mobile-drawer { display: block; }

      .hero-image-area { display: none; }
      .hero-content { max-width: 100%; padding: 60px 0 100px; }

      .mission-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 40px; }
      .mission-visual { max-width: 500px; }

      .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }

      .involved-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; max-width: 500px; margin: 0 auto; }

      .donate-cta-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 48px; }

      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .footer-brand { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .hero { min-height: 80vh; }
      .hero-title { font-size: 36px; }
      .hero-subtitle { font-size: 16px; }

      .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
      .stat-card { padding: 28px 20px; }
      .stat-number { font-size: 36px; }

      .news-card { flex: 0 0 100%; }

      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 32px; }
      .footer-bottom { flex-direction: column; text-align: center; }

      .amount-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .container { padding: 0 16px; }
      .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .hero-actions { flex-direction: column; }
      .hero-actions .btn { width: 100%; }
      .amount-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .footer-brand { grid-column: auto; }
    }
  </style>
</head>

Every day, our teams work across borders and boundaries to ensure that help reaches those who need it most — regardless of race, religion, nationality, or political affiliation. From the first hours of a disaster to the years of recovery that follow, we stand with affected communities <strong>every step of the way</strong>.

  <script>
    // ===== HEADER SCROLL EFFECT =====
    const header = document.getElementById('header');
    let lastScroll = 0;
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      const scrollY = window.scrollY;
      if (scrollY > 10) {
        header.classList.add('scrolled');
      } else {
        header.classList.remove('scrolled');
      }
      lastScroll = scrollY;
    }, { passive: true });

    // ===== MOBILE MENU =====
    const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
    const mobileDrawer = document.getElementById('mobileDrawer');

    hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const isOpen = hamburger.classList.toggle('active');
      mobileDrawer.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
      mobileDrawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', !isOpen);
      document.body.style.overflow = isOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
    });

    // Close mobile menu on link click
    mobileDrawer.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => {
      link.addEventListener('click', () => {
        hamburger.classList.remove('active');
        mobileDrawer.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        mobileDrawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
      });
    });

    // ===== DONATE MODAL =====
    const donateModal = document.getElementById('donateModal');
    const modalClose = document.getElementById('modalClose');
    const donateTriggers = document.querySelectorAll('.donate-trigger');
    const amountGrid = document.getElementById('amountGrid');
    const customAmountInput = document.getElementById('customAmount');
    const frequencyToggle = document.getElementById('frequencyToggle');
    const confirmDonate = document.getElementById('confirmDonate');
    let selectedAmount = 50;
    let selectedFreq = 'one-time';

    function openModal() {
      donateModal.classList.add('open');
      donateModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      donateModal.querySelector('.modal-close').focus();
    }

    function closeModal() {
      donateModal.classList.remove('open');
      donateModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    donateTriggers.forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', openModal));
    modalClose.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
    donateModal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === donateModal) closeModal();
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && donateModal.classList.contains('open')) closeModal();
    });

    // Amount selection
    amountGrid.querySelectorAll('.amount-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        amountGrid.querySelectorAll('.amount-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
        btn.classList.add('selected');
        selectedAmount = parseInt(btn.dataset.amount);
        customAmountInput.value = '';
        updateConfirmBtn();
      });
    });

    customAmountInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
      if (customAmountInput.value) {
        amountGrid.querySelectorAll('.amount-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
        selectedAmount = parseInt(customAmountInput.value) || 0;
      }
      updateConfirmBtn();
    });

    // Frequency toggle
    frequencyToggle.querySelectorAll('.freq-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        frequencyToggle.querySelectorAll('.freq-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
        btn.classList.add('selected');
        selectedFreq = btn.dataset.freq;
        updateConfirmBtn();
      });
    });

    function updateConfirmBtn() {
      const amount = selectedAmount || 0;
      const suffix = selectedFreq === 'monthly' ? '/month' : '';
      confirmDonate.textContent = `Donate $${amount.toLocaleString()}${suffix}`;
    }

    // ===== PROGRAM ACCORDION =====
    const accordionItems = document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-item');
    accordionItems.forEach((item, index) => {
      const trigger = item.querySelector('.accordion-trigger');
      const content = item.querySelector('.accordion-content');

      // Set first item open by default
      if (index === 0) {
        item.classList.add('active');
        content.style.maxHeight = content.scrollHeight + 'px';
      }

      trigger.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const isActive = item.classList.contains('active');

        // Close all
        accordionItems.forEach(i => {
          i.classList.remove('active');
          i.querySelector('.accordion-trigger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          i.querySelector('.accordion-content').style.maxHeight = '0';
        });

        // Open clicked if it wasn't active
        if (!isActive) {
          item.classList.add('active');
          trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
          content.style.maxHeight = content.scrollHeight + 'px';
        }
      });
    });

    // ===== NEWS CAROUSEL =====
    const newsTrack = document.getElementById('newsTrack');
    const prevBtn = document.getElementById('carouselPrev');
    const nextBtn = document.getElementById('carouselNext');
    let carouselIndex = 0;

    function getCardsPerView() {
      if (window.innerWidth <= 768) return 1;
      return 2;
    }

    function getTotalCards() {
      return newsTrack.querySelectorAll('.news-card').length;
    }

    function updateCarousel() {
      const cardsPerView = getCardsPerView();
      const totalCards = getTotalCards();
      const maxIndex = Math.max(0, totalCards - cardsPerView);
      carouselIndex = Math.min(carouselIndex, maxIndex);

      const card = newsTrack.querySelector('.news-card');
      const gap = 28;
      const cardWidth = card.offsetWidth + gap;
      newsTrack.style.transform = `translateX(-${carouselIndex * cardWidth}px)`;
    }

    prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (carouselIndex > 0) {
        carouselIndex--;
        updateCarousel();
      }
    });

    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const cardsPerView = getCardsPerView();
      const totalCards = getTotalCards();
      const maxIndex = Math.max(0, totalCards - cardsPerView);
      if (carouselIndex < maxIndex) {
        carouselIndex++;
        updateCarousel();
      }
    });

    window.addEventListener('resize', updateCarousel);

    // ===== ANIMATED COUNTERS =====
    function animateCounter(el) {
      const target = parseInt(el.dataset.target);
      const prefix = el.dataset.prefix || '';
      const suffix = el.dataset.suffix || '';
      const duration = 2000;
      const start = performance.now();

      function easeOutQuart(t) {
        return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 4);
      }

      function update(now) {
        const elapsed = now - start;
        const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
        const easedProgress = easeOutQuart(progress);
        const current = Math.floor(easedProgress * target);

        el.textContent = prefix + current.toLocaleString() + (progress >= 1 ? suffix : '');

        if (progress < 1) {
          requestAnimationFrame(update);
        }
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(update);
    }

    // ===== SCROLL REVEAL =====
    const revealElements = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
    const statNumbers = document.querySelectorAll('.stat-number');
    let statsAnimated = false;

    const observerOptions = {
      threshold: 0.15,
      rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px'
    };

    const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('visible');

          // Animate stats when they become visible
          if (!statsAnimated && entry.target.querySelector('.stat-number')) {
            statsAnimated = true;
            statNumbers.forEach(el => animateCounter(el));
          }

          revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, observerOptions);

    revealElements.forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));

    // Also observe stat cards directly
    const statsSection = document.querySelector('.stats-grid');
    if (statsSection) {
      const statsObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting && !statsAnimated) {
            statsAnimated = true;
            statNumbers.forEach(el => animateCounter(el));
            statsObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.3 });
      statsObserver.observe(statsSection);
    }

    // ===== SMOOTH SCROLL FOR ANCHOR LINKS =====
    document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
      anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        const href = this.getAttribute('href');
        if (href === '#') return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const target = document.querySelector(href);
        if (target) {
          const headerHeight = 72;
          const targetPosition = target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - headerHeight;
          window.scrollTo({ top: targetPosition, behavior: 'smooth' });
        }
      });
    });
  </script>
